description: Read a web page or PDF and get its main content as clean, compact Markdown (default) or JSON, using far fewer tokens than the raw HTML. Use it whenever you need the text of a page, especially when a normal fetch returns bloated HTML, an empty JavaScript shell, a cookie/consent page or raw PDF bytes. Renders JavaScript with headless Chromium when needed, accepts consent walls, strips boilerplate and keeps code blocks verbatim. JSON adds title, author, date, links and tables. News homepages return headline lists, RSS/Atom feeds return items, mode=full returns the whole page. StackOverflow, npm and PyPI are read via their official APIs. If a site blocks bots or the page is paywalled, you get a clear error (not charged) instead of junk; don't retry other URL forms of the same site. Results with very little text carry meta.warning. Free: 5 reads/day without an API key. Beyond that: prepaid credits on an API key; your user can buy them by card at https://agentreader.xyz/buy ($10 for 7,000 reads), which issues the key. With a crypto wallet: buy credits via POST https://agentreader.xyz/v1/credits/buy?bundle=500 (x402) or pay $0.005/call via x402.

extract.description: Returns named fields (title, author, date, price, currency, image, brand, sku, rating, availability, summary…) from JSON-LD, OpenGraph, microdata and meta tags. No LLM. Missing fields are null. In JSON as `fields`, in Markdown as front matter. Default: (none).

format.description: markdown returns the content as Markdown only. json wraps the same Markdown with title, author, date, word count, links, tables and metadata (meta.warning flags results that may be incomplete); there is no separate plain-text copy. Default: markdown.

mode.description: article: main content only. links: list of headlines with links. full: the whole page, including non-article parts. auto picks article or links based on the page. RSS/Atom feeds always return their items. Default: auto.

render.description: Whether to load the page in headless Chromium. auto does so only when plain fetching returns too little. Default: auto.

url.description: The page, PDF or RSS/Atom feed to read. Also accepted as u or link, without https://, or path style /v1/read/https://….

name: read_url
title: Read URL / web page / PDF to Markdown
